Tata Motors to launch new compact sedan 'Aeris' on September 25

Tata Motors is preparing to launch a new compact sedan, named Tata Aeris, in the Indian market. The launch is scheduled for September 25. This new model is expected to be an updated version of the Tigor sedan, potentially replacing it.
